masala_buttermilk.name: Masala Buttermilk
method: Mix very well and make sure it is lumps free
Prepare the tadka (heat oil, add rai and green chili)
Pour the tadka on the above mixture
Can chill the buttermilk in the refrigerator and serve later. Use it in the same day

plain_buttermilk.name: Plain Buttermilk
method: Shake in the wisher for some minutes till everything is blended well
Can chill the buttermilk in the refrigerator and serve later

solkadhi.name: Solkadhi
method: In a bowl, add water, coconut milk, kokum syrup, kokum agal, garlic, ginger, green chili
Stir well to mix and garnish with green coriander
Taste it and adjust seasoning as required
Garnish the Solkadhi with chopped coriander and serve chilled

masala_kokam.name: Masala Kokam
method: In a bowl, add water, kokum syrup, kokum agal, garlic, ginger, and chili spice paste and stir well to combine
If required, filter the above mixture
Taste it and adjust seasoning as required
Garnish with chopped coriander and serve chilled

kokam.name: Kokam
method: In a bowl, add water, kokum syrup, jeera powder, salt and stir well to combine
Taste it and adjust seasoning as required

limbu_pani.name: Limbu Pani
method: Slice the lemon and squeeze the juice into water. Discard the seed. Add sugar, salt
Take water in a vessel and ice cubes
Mix all until sugar dissolves. Pour into tall glasses and add lemon slices if using

masala_lemon.name: Masala Lemon
method: Slice the lemon and squeeze the juice into water. Discard the seed. Add sugar, salt
Take water in a vessel and ice cubes
Mix all until sugar dissolves. Add jaljeera powder 2 tbsp. Mix everything well until dissolved
Add ice cubes and serve cool

awala.name: Awala
method: Take water in a container, add awala syrup in it

aam_panha.name: Aam Panha
method: Cook the raw mango in a cooker for 2 whistles
Once it cools down, take the pulp and make a smooth puree
Add water as per consistency required

tea_masala.name: Tea & Masala Tea
tea_masala.display: Tea & Masala Tea / चहा आणि मसाला चहा
method: Add tea powder and boil for 3-4 minutes on medium flame
Add milk and boil over medium flame for 6-7 minutes
Turn off the gas and strain tea in cups

kandabhaji.name: Kanda Bhaji
method: Slice the onions thinly and place in a mixing bowl. Add a pinch of salt and lemon juice and mix well
Keep this bowl untouched for 5 minutes
Add haldi powder, cumin powder, red chili powder, coriander leaves, water, besan, salt
Mix the besan, salt, and oil very well with the onions
Allow the mixture to rest for 5 to 6 minutes
Add a spoonful of batter to the hot oil
Fry the bhajis on a medium flame until golden brown
Serve hot with fried green chilies and green chutney

appa_pakoda.name: Appa Pakoda
method: Soak the dal for about 12 hours. Add black pepper
Grind the soaked dal in a mixture blender
Add onion, green chili paste, jeera powder, cilantro, and salt. Mix well
Heat the oil in a wok. Drop spoonfuls of batter and fry till golden brown

kothimbir_vadi.name: Kothimbir Vadi
method: Clean and chop coriander leaves. Wash and dry completely
Heat kadhai, add oil and mustard seeds to crackle
Add green chili paste and chopped green chili
Mix chopped dry fruits and khaskhas
Add haldi and hing and sauté well
Add coriander and salt. Remove and add hot water slowly
Add amchur powder. Apply oil on a plate and spread the batter
Steam for 15-20 minutes. Let it cool and cut into diamond pieces
Heat oil and deep fry until light golden

kachori.name: Kachori
ingredients: For Stuffing: Green peas: 1 kg, Vada Pav masala: 250 gm, Ginger paste: 50 gm, Garlic paste: 50gm, Amchur powder: 25 gm, Turmeric powder: 20 gm, Salt, Jeera powder: 20 gm, Besan: 150 gm, Oil: 500ml, Rai: 1tbsp, Sugar: 2 pinch
For Dough: Maida: 250 grms, Hot oil (Mohan): 20 ml, Salt: 10 grms, Hot Water
method: Make masala: Put oil and mustard, add ginger, garlic, green chili paste, all powders, vada pav masala
Add green peas paste, then fried besan
Add sugar, salt, amchur to taste
For dough: add maida, mohan oil, salt. Knead to form dough. Cover for 15 minutes
Scoop stuffing, get edges together and form a bundle
Gently press and flatten. Deep fry kachoris

khasta_kachori.name: Khasta Kachori
ingredients: For covering: Maida: 200 gm, Salt: 5 gm, Oil: 50 ml, Curd: 50 ml, Cumin seeds: 1 gm, Hot water: 50 ml

For stuffing: Soaked yellow moong dal: 200 gm, oil: 100 ml, Cumin: 2 gm, Besan: 100 gm, Hing: 1 gm, Turmeric: 1 gm, Red chili powder: 10 gm, Roasted fennel seeds: 20 gm, Coriander powder: 20 gm, Green coriander: 30 gm, Salt: 5 gm, Amchur powder: 2 gm, Water: 200 ml
method: Soak moong dal 6-7 hours, drain and crush in grinder
Make dough using maida, salt, oil, curd, cumin, and hot water
Make stuffing with besan and spices in kadhai
Add crushed moong dal and cook with water
Roll dough, fill masala, pack like modak
Deep-fry on low flame. Serve with chutneys

masvadi.name: Masvadi
ingredients: For Stuffing: Chopped Onion: 2 big, Dry grated Coconut: 50g, Red chili powder: 1 tsp, Turmeric: 1/2 tsp, Garlic cloves: 7-8, White sesame seeds: 4 tbsp, Peanut: 50g, Salt, Coriander leaves, Ginger, Khas khas, Cumin seeds, Hing
For Cover: Besan: 250g, Hing: 1/4 tsp, Ginger-Garlic paste: 1 tsp, Turmeric powder: 1/4 tsp, Salt, Water: 1.25 cup, Oil: 2 tbsp, Red chili powder: 1 tsp
method: Dry roast khas khas, coconut, sesame seeds, groundnuts, then onion with oil
Grind into coarse powder, cook with masalas
For cover: Heat oil, add all spices, hot water, besan. Mix and cook
Roll besan mixture, add stuffing, fold into triangular shape
Cut into pieces, garnish with coriander and coconut

pudachi_vadi.name: Pudachi Vadi
ingredients: For Cover: Besan: 250g, Maida: 100g, Turmeric: 1/4 tsp, Salt, Red chilli powder, Hot oil (mohan), Water, Oil for frying
For stuffing: Green coriander, Kaju badam kismis chopped, Salt, Dry grated Coconut: 50g, Mirchi chopped: 2 tbsp, Kala masala: 1 tsp, Sugar, Khas khas, Jeera powder, Mustard seeds
method: Mix besan, maida with salt and spices. Add hot oil and knead stiff dough
Make stuffing with all ingredients in kadhai
Roll dough like poori, spread kala masala chutney
Add stuffing, fold from sides, press well
Deep fry on low to medium heat until crispy

mix_dal_vada.name: Mix Dal Vada
mix_dal_vada.display: Mix Dal Vada / मिक्स डाळ वडा
ingredients: Oil for tadka and deep frying
method: Wash and soak all dals for 3-4 hours. Drain water
Grind soaked dal with green chilies and ginger to coarse paste
Add onion, coriander, salt and mix well
Pour tadka (oil, hing, curry leaves) on batter
Heat oil, take batter, make small balls, flatten and fry till golden brown

batata_vada.name: Batata Vada
method: Heat oil, add rai, hing, curry leaves, green chili, ginger, garlic paste, haldi
Add mashed potatoes, salt, coriander. Mix well
Make besan batter with haldi, red chili powder, salt, water
Dip potato balls in batter and deep fry till golden

goti_vada.name: Goti Vada
method: Clean, wash and chop fresh green methi
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, ginger paste, green chilies, hing, spices
Add water, salt, and boil. Add ground chana dal
Cover for 15 minutes, make small oval vadas
Deep fry and serve with green chutney

alu_vadi.name: Alu Vadi
method: Mix besan, rice flour with all spices and tamarind paste
Apply paste on cleaned alu leaves, make rolls
Once cool, cut into rounds and deep fry

bread_pakoda.name: Bread Pakoda
method: Cut edges of bread slices. Apply different chutneys
Place aloo mixture on two slices, cover with third
Cut in diagonal to get triangles
Dip in besan batter and deep fry till golden crispy
Serve with fried green chili and tamarind chutney

karela_fry.name: Karela Fry
method: Wash and peel karela slightly, cut into round rings
Season with salt and turmeric, keep aside for 5 min
Drain water and deep fry till crispy
Add red chili powder, chaat masala, salt if needed

fodanachi_ukad.name: Fodanachi Ukad
method: Grind soaked rice into fine paste
Heat oil, add jeera, green chilies, curry leaves, hing
Add coconut and rice batter, cook with ghee till becomes modak atta
Make balls with well in middle, steam for 15 min

puranpoli.name: Puran Poli
ingredients: For filling: Chana Dal: 1 kg, Jaggery Grated: 700g, Sugar: 300g, Oil: 200g, Ghee: 200g, Nutmeg Powder: 1, Ginger: 25g
For dough: Maida: 600g, Wheat atta: 400g, Salt: 1 pinch, Water
method: Mix flour, salt and oil. Add water and make soft dough
Cover and keep aside for 30 minutes
Grind cooked chana dal with jaggery
Heat jaggery and ghee, cook until dissolved
Cook until mixture leaves sides of pan, add nutmeg
Roll dough, place filling, bring ends together
Cook on griddle, apply ghee and fry until golden

gajar_halwa.name: Gajar Halwa
method: Wash, peel, and grate the carrots
Heat ghee, roast dry fruits for one minute
Add grated carrot, cook for 10-15 minutes
Add milk, let it boil and cook for 30 minutes on low flame
Cook until all milk evaporates and khoya forms
Garnish with dry fruits, serve warm or cold

basundi.name: Basundi
ingredients: Green cardamom seeds powder: ¼ teaspoon
method: Take milk in a heavy bottom pan, bring to boil
Reduce heat to medium, keep stirring till it gets half quantity
Mix in sugar, cardamom powder and simmer
Mix well and simmer for 5 minutes
Should be thick yet runny consistency

khava_poli.name: Khava Poli
method: Heat khawa in micro oven, let cool and mix well
Make soft dough with maida, salt, oil, and water
Roll dough into puri size, place stuffing
Close and roll into thin poli
Cook on tava, apply ghee and flip

chirotte.name: Chirotte
method: Mix all ingredients with fingertips until crumbly
Knead dough with warm water, rest for 15 minutes
Roll out 2-3 polis, spread satta, place on each other
Make long roll, cut into pieces, press with thumb
Deep fry on low flame until golden
Sprinkle powdered sugar, store when cool

gulshel.name: Gulshel (Pumpkin Kheer)
method: Roast grated pumpkin in ghee until separates
Add khoa and mix well, then add milk

ukadiche_modak.name: Ukadiche Modak
method: For stuffing: Mix grated coconut with jaggery in pan, cook until dry
For dough: Boil water with salt and ghee, add rice flour quickly
Cover and cook 2-3 minutes, knead into smooth dough

moong_dal_halwa.name: Moong Dal Halwa
moong_dal_halwa.display: Moong Dal Halwa / मूग डाळ हलवा
method: Grind into smooth paste without water
Heat ghee, add dal paste, keep stirring
Add hot milk, cook till thick like cream
Add khoa, then sugar, stir until grainy

rava_sheera.name: Rava Sheera
method: Heat ghee, add Rava and roast on low heat till fragrant
Add milk, saffron, and cardamom powder. Cover and cook
Add sugar, cover and cook till it melts

aamrakhand.name: Aamrakhand
method: In a bowl, mix all ingredients thoroughly except badam

naral_cha_ladoo.name: Naral Cha Ladoo
method: Heat ghee, add fresh coconut grated, sauté well
Cook until it leaves the sides of kadhai
Cool down and make small ladoo

sakhar_bhaat.name: Sakhar Bhaat
method: Heat ghee, add cloves and fresh grated coconut
Add milk, sugar, and saffron soaked in warm milk

fried_modak.name: Fried Modak
ingredients: For stuffing: Dry grated coconut: 250 gm, Sugar: 100 gm, Milk: 50 ml, Ghee: 25g, Cardamom powder
For covering: Maida: 200 gm, Rawa: 100 gm, Ghee: 75 ml, Salt: a pinch, Water, Oil for frying
method: Make stuffing with coconut, sugar, milk, ghee
Make dough with maida, rawa, ghee, salt
Shape into modak and deep fry

shrikhand.name: Shrikhand
method: Hang curd overnight to drain water
Mix hung curd with sugar until smooth

piyush.name: Piyush
method: Mix shrikhand with curd and milk, whisk well

rose_piyush.name: Rose Piyush
method: Mix shrikhand with rose water and milk, whisk well
Add cinnamon and black pepper powder

mango_piyush.name: Mango Piyush
method: Mix shrikhand with mango pulp and milk
Whisk well to make lump-free mixture

aliv_kheer.name: Aliv Kheer
method: Heat ghee, add aliv and sauté till they crackle
Add milk and sugar, cook well

nachani_chi_kheer.name: Nachani Chi Kheer
method: Heat ghee, add nachani flour and roast well

aloo_bhaji.name: Aloo Bhaji (Dry)
ingredients: Green Chili, curry leaves, ginger paste
method: Add hing, green chili, curry leaves, ginger paste, haldi

batata_cauliflower.name: Batata with Cauliflower
method: Add vegetables to reduce oil temperature
Add hot water, cover for 5 min
Cook till tender, garnish with coriander

bharli_vangi.name: Bharli Vangi
ingredients: For stuffing: Baby brinjals: 500g, Peanuts powder: 150g, Desiccated coconut: 50g, Garlic paste: 1 tbsp, Ginger paste: 1 tbsp, Turmeric: ½ tsp, Red chilly powder: 1 tsp, Jeera powder: ½ tsp, Salt, Coriander
For curry: Onion paste: 100g, Coconut: 50g, Shengadana powder: 100g, Tomato paste: 50g, All spices, Goda masala: 4 tsp, Oil: 5 tbsp, Water: 500 ml
method: Wash brinjals, slit into 4, soak in salted water
Dry roast peanuts and coconut, grind to coarse powder
Make curry base with onion, tomato, coconut paste
Add brinjals, water, salt and cook for 30-35 minutes

bhendi_bhaji.name: Bhendi Bhaji
method: Wash bhindi, dry and cut into round pieces
Heat oil, add mustard and green chillies
Add sliced onions, cook till soft
Add all spices, sauté on low flame
Add bhindi, mix carefully, add lemon
Add salt, cook till soft, add coriander

zhunka.name: Zhunka
method: Heat oil, splutter mustard, curry leaves, hing
Add garlic ginger paste, sliced onion
Add water, let it boil, add besan
Sauté on low flame for 5 minutes

bharali_bhendi.name: Bharali Bhendi
method: Clean bhendi, give slit cut in middle
Make stuffing with all powder spices
Heat oil, add rai, hing, green chili
Add stuffed bhendi, cover and cook

akkha_masoor.name: Akkha Masoor
ingredients: For green masala: Green chillies: 3, Garlic: 6 cloves, Ginger: 1 inch, Coriander: 10 gm, Dry coconut roasted
Main: Masoor Dal: 150g (soaked 3 hrs), Oil: 6 tbsp, Rai: ¼ tsp, Onion, Tomato paste, All spices, Goda masala: 1 tsp, Salt, Amchur, Green coriander
method: Heat oil, add rai, onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes
Add green masala paste, sauté well
Add all dry spices with water

barbati_usal.name: Barbati Usal
method: Heat oil, add mustard seeds, sauté 1 minute
Add onions, fry till light brown
Add ginger paste, sauté 2 more minutes
Add water and pressure cook for 3 whistles

kaju_curry.name: Kaju Curry
method: Heat oil, add rai, tej patta, onion paste
Add garlic ginger paste, tomato paste
Sauté well, add dry spices with water
Add hot water for gravy consistency
Add jaggery, salt, lemon zest, soaked kaju

special_kadhi.name: Special Kadhi (Mutke)
ingredients: Salt, Sugar, Lemon, Ginger paste, Ghee
method: Mix besan, curd, turmeric in mixer, add water
Heat oil, add rai, chopped garlic
Add methi dana, green chilies, curry leaves, hing, cloves
Add water for consistency, cook thoroughly
Add lemon, ginger paste, ghee, salt, sugar

lasun_curry_dal.name: Lasun Curry Leaves Goda Masala Dal
lasun_curry_dal.display: Lasun Curry Leaves Dal / लसूण डाळ
method: Heat oil, add rai, chopped garlic till golden
Add green chili, curry leaves, hing, turmeric, goda masala
Add hot water, then boiled dal

sev_bhaji_rassa.name: Sev Bhaji Rassa
sev_bhaji_rassa.display: Sev Bhaji Rassa / शेव भाजी रस्सा
ingredients: For rassa: Oil: 3 tbsp, Rai: ¼ tsp, Onion slice: 100gm, Garlic: 5 gm, Ginger: 5 gm, All spices, Goda masala: 3 gm, Salt, Sugar, Amchur, Dry coconut
For sev: Besan: 200gm, Wheat flour: 50 gm, Garlic paste, Ginger paste, All spices, Curd: 40 gm
method: Make rassa: Heat oil, add rai, sauté coconut till brown
Add onion, ginger, garlic, make paste
For sev: Mix besan, wheat flour with all spices
Make batter, drop directly in rassa

wala_cha_bhirade.name: Wala Cha Bhirade
method: Add onion, ginger, green chili, coconut, tomato paste
Add all dry spices with hot water
Add salt, sugar, goda masala, coriander

masale_bhaat.name: Masale Bhaat
method: Fry onions, add all vegetables and spices

plain_rice.name: Plain Rice
method: Boil water with salt and ghee

tandalachi_bhakri.name: Tandalachi Bhakri
method: Add hot boiling water and mix well
Knead dough for at least 5 minutes
Heat tawa, place bhakri, apply water on top
Roast till water evaporates, flip and cook
Roast on direct flame from both sides

jowar_bhakri.name: Jowar Bhakri
method: Add hot water to jowar flour
Cook on tawa from both sides

chapati.name: Chapati
method: Mix flour with salt and water
Knead into soft dough, rest for 15 min
Cook on hot tawa from both sides

puri.name: Puri
method: Mix flour with salt and a little oil
Deep fry till puffed and golden

balgopal_aloo_bhaji.name: Balgopal Aloochi Bhaji
balgopal_aloo_bhaji.display: Balgopal Aloochi Bhaji / बालगोपाल आलू भाजी
method: Heat oil, add rai and let splutter, add hing
Add ginger and curry leaves paste, sauté well
Add turmeric, mashed boiled potatoes, salt, coriander

balgopal_misal_pav.name: Balgopal Misal Pav
balgopal_misal_pav.display: Balgopal Misal Pav / बालगोपाल मिसळ पाव
method: Make less spicy curry for children
Serve with pav, curd and tamarind chutney

green_chutney.name: Green Chutney
method: Grind all ingredients into fine smooth paste
Taste it and serve with snacks

dry_thecha.name: Dry Thecha
method: Grind all ingredients into coarse form except lemon

thecha_green_chilly.name: Thecha Green Chilly
thecha_green_chilly.display: Thecha Green Chilly / हिरव्या मिरचीचा ठेचा
method: Break stalk of green chilies, wash and drain
Heat oil, add cumin, garlic, dry coconut
Add green chilies and salt, sauté well
Add lemon juice or amchur, store in freeze

thecha_red_chilly.name: Thecha Red Chilly
thecha_red_chilly.display: Thecha Red Chilly / लाल मिरचीचा ठेचा
method: Break stalk of red chilies, wash and drain
Heat oil, add cumin, garlic, dry coconut
Add red chilies and salt, sauté well
Add lemon juice or amchur, store in freeze

tamarind_chutney.name: Tamarind Chutney
method: Clean tamarind, boil with double water
Boil strained puree with jaggery and sugar

vada_pav_chutney.name: Vada Pav Chutney
vada_pav_chutney.display: Vada Pav Chutney / वडा पाव चटणी

sabudana_chutney.name: Sabudana Chutney
method: Mix all ingredients in a bowl

panchamrut.name: Panchamrut
method: Cut bitter gourd in rings and deseed
Heat oil, add rai, karela rings till crispy
Add green chilies, curry leaves, hing
Add jaggery, sugar, salt, red chilly powder

gajar_koshimber.name: Gajar Koshimber
method: Place grated carrots in mixing bowl
Add lime juice, salt and sugar

lauki_koshimber.name: Lauki Koshimber
method: Steam or pressure cook bottle gourd
Whisk curd with salt and sugar
Add cooled bottle gourd to curd
Make tempering with oil, mustard, chilies, hing, haldi

onion_tomato_koshimber.name: Onion Tomato Koshimber
onion_tomato_koshimber.display: Onion Tomato Koshimber / कांदा टोमॅटो कोशिंबीर
method: Make tempering with oil, mustard, green chilies, turmeric

pachaddi_koshimbir.name: Pachaddi Koshimbir
method: Chop cabbage finely, drain water after 10 min
Make tempering with oil, mustard, green chilies, turmeric

kakdi_koshimber.name: Kakdi Koshimber
method: Mix with whisked curd, salt, sugar
Make tempering with mustard, green chilies
Add tempering and garnish with coriander

misal_usal.name: Misal Usal
method: In a quarter plate, first take matki

turichya_daliche_mutke.name: Turichya Daliche Mutke
turichya_daliche_mutke.display: Turichya Daliche Mutke / तुरीच्या डाळीचे मुटके
method: Drain soaked toor dal, grind in mixer
Grind ginger, garlic, green chili, coriander
Mix all ingredients with dal, coconut, curd

kombadi_vade.name: Kombadi Vade
method: Mix rice flour with cumin seeds and salt
Add hot water to make dough

moong_dal_pakoda.name: Moong Dal Pakoda
moong_dal_pakoda.display: Moong Dal Pakoda / मूग डाळ पकोडा
method: Soak green moong dal overnight and wash well
Grind into coarse paste with chilies, ginger, garlic and salt
Add all ingredients with besan, coriander leaves, and rice flour
Drop small amounts in hot oil and deep-fry till crisp

palak_pakoda.name: Palak Pakoda
method: Rinse palak well and finely chop
Add all spices and besan to chopped palak
Mix well and add water as required for batter
Drop spoonfuls in medium hot oil
Fry until golden, serve with chutney

dadpe_pohe.name: Dadpe Pohe
method: Dry thin poha and keep aside
Mix poha with buttermilk till soggy
Add coconut, sugar, salt and mix well
Make tadka with mustard, hing, chili, kaju
Pour tadka over poha and mix

dhirade.name: Dhirade
method: Mix all flours with curd and spices
Add water to make thick batter

balgopal_sabudana_khichadi.name: Balgopal Sabudana Khichadi
balgopal_sabudana_khichadi.display: Balgopal Sabudana Khichadi / बालगोपाल साबुदाणा खिचडी
method: Cook on low flame - keep mild for kids

balgopal_sabudana_vada.name: Balgopal Sabudana Vada
balgopal_sabudana_vada.display: Balgopal Sabudana Vada / बालगोपाल साबुदाणा वडा
method: Add peanut powder, cumin and salt
Serve with curd - mild for kids

balgopal_aloo_paratha.name: Balgopal Aloo Paratha
balgopal_aloo_paratha.display: Balgopal Aloo Paratha / बालगोपाल आलू पराठा
method: Make soft dough with flour and water

balgopal_kanda_poha.name: Balgopal Kanda Poha
balgopal_kanda_poha.display: Balgopal Kanda Poha / बालगोपाल कांदा पोहा
method: Add salt and sugar - keep mild

shirvale.name: Shirvale
method: Make shirvale shape using special mold
Prepare coconut milk syrup with jaggery

tilgul_poli.name: Tilgul Poli
method: Mix with grated jaggery and cardamom

sevya_chi_kheer.name: Sevya Chi Kheer
method: Boil milk and add roasted vermicelli

gulab_jamun.name: Gulab Jamun
method: Mix khoya and maida to make dough
Deep fry on low heat until golden
Soak in warm syrup for 2-3 hours

dhanush_barfi.name: Dhanush Barfi
method: Heat khoya and cook till thick

ukarpendi.name: Ukarpendi
method: Heat oil, add onion and saute

thalipith.name: Thalipith
method: Mix flour with onion, chili, cumin, salt
Pat into thick round on tawa
Cook with oil on both sides

vangyache_bharit.name: Vangyache Bharit
method: Roast brinjal on flame till charred

instant_curry_aloo.name: Instant Curry Aloo
instant_curry_aloo.display: Instant Curry Aloo / इन्स्टंट करी आलू

pithala.name: Pithala
method: Heat oil, saute onion and garlic

katachi_aamti.name: Katachi Aamti
method: Use water from boiling chana dal for puran poli
Add coconut paste and goda masala

dahi_bhat.name: Dahi Bhat
method: Make tempering with mustard, curry leaves

truty_fruty_rice.name: Tutti Frutti Rice
truty_fruty_rice.display: Tutti Frutti Rice / टुट्टी फ्रुट्टी भात

fodaniche_varan.name: Fodaniche Varan
method: Make tadka with ghee, garlic, cumin

chincha_gulacha_varan.name: Chincha Gulacha Varan
chincha_gulacha_varan.display: Chincha Gulacha Varan / चिंच गुळाचे वरण

gol_matol_aloo_curry.name: Gol Matol Aloo Curry
gol_matol_aloo_curry.display: Gol Matol Aloo Curry / गोल मटोल आलू करी

dry_stuff_brinjal.name: Dry Stuffed Brinjal
dry_stuff_brinjal.display: Dry Stuffed Brinjal / सुक्या भरल्या वांग्या

onion_tomato_special_bhaji.name: Onion Tomato Special Bhaji
onion_tomato_special_bhaji.display: Onion Tomato Special / कांदा टोमॅटो स्पेशल

phulka.name: Phulka
method: Cook on tawa then on flame to puff

sabudana_khichdi.name: Sabudana Khichdi
method: Heat ghee, add cumin and chili
Cook on low flame till translucent

fasting_aloo_bhaji.name: Fasting Aloo Bhaji
fasting_aloo_bhaji.display: Fasting Aloo Bhaji / उपवास आलू भाजी

fasting_aloo_sheera.name: Fasting Aloo Sheera
fasting_aloo_sheera.display: Fasting Aloo Sheera / उपवास आलू शिरा

green_chutney_sunday.name: Green Chutney (Sunday)
green_chutney_sunday.display: Sunday Green Chutney / रविवार हिरवी चटणी

mokali_dal_chutney.name: Mokali Dal Chutney
